item.description:
A new look for the editor window

  • Tools on a shelf. View, Fill, Sign, Shrink, Combine & split and To Markdown now sit at the top of the sidebar (⌘1–⌘6). Fill shows how many blanks are left. Click “Tools” to fold the shelf down to the one you’re using.
  • Pages that show your progress. While filling, each page shows how many blanks are left, or a green tick when it’s done.
  • The boy has a seat. He sits on a card at the bottom of the sidebar: facts about the PDF when you’re reading, your progress and a tip while you fill, and a little celebration with Save Copy when everything is filled.
  • A calmer toolbar. Just the title, search (⌘F), zoom and one main button.
  • Hide the sidebar and the tools fold into a slim rail, with your progress as a ring around the boy.
  • Warmer colours throughout: a cream sidebar and a dotted desk behind the page, in Light and Dark Mode.

Also

  • PDFs now open for viewing; Fill is one click (or ⌘2) away.
  • Shrink tells you when a PDF can’t get meaningfully smaller, instead of offering a save that wouldn’t help.
